source_acquisition: Official NIH page text returned by public web search index; direct HTTP 403. Whitespace normalized manually against indexed body.
source_scope: Title, date, subtitle, all nine editorial body paragraphs, grant and reference. Institutional boilerplate, navigation, logos and images excluded. Not the full journal paper.
source_permission_assessment: Reviewed NIH editorial text under NIH FAQ; public-domain text assessment, not automatic domain-wide permission. No third-party image or Nature paper included.
execution_boundary: Isolated one-shot candidate trial via shared App Server; candidate-specific approval, durable attempt receipt BEFORE turn/start, no retries on unknown delivery. Production binding and activation remain separate.
before_execution: Confirm this exact report and packet digests, candidate, effort, Standard speed and acceptance limit. Live catalog compatibility is checked again by run.
acceptance: Exactly one delivered turn; raw response and usage retained.
Valid strict JSON, complete=true; Czech translation covers every editorial paragraph and reference.
Preserve less than 10%, more than 80%, 90%, gene names and grant.
AAV delivery is planned; no successful patient treatment or in-body experiment claimed.
No write to live queue/archive, no weekly service; uncertain outcome blocks another attempt.
account_mode_required: chatgpt; apiKey and unknown are blocked before thread/start
timeout_note: 90 seconds bounds each transport wait, not the total streamed turn duration. Any uncertain timeout blocks another attempt.

integration.next_step: Will takes only this new local commit into current main, resolves any context conflicts and reruns applicable target tests; paid trial stays in Data worktree. No merge/rebase/push/deploy performed.
